description: Turn only those obstruction-derived filters that survive witness audits into an approved filter bank. Every candidate rule must prove it does not kill known 42- or 43-vertex witnesses.
mathematical_formalization: A filter f is admissible only if for every known witness H, f(H)=safe, and for every tested failure family, f removes a positive fraction of impossible extensions.
implementation_hypothesis: Audit each candidate rule independently against known witnesses before composing them into a bank.
experiment_seed: Create a witness-survival matrix with rows = known witnesses and columns = candidate filters.

closest_prior_art.title: Decreasing the upper bound on the Ramsey number R(5,5)
Ramsey Number Counterexample Checking and One Vertex Extension Linearly Bound by s and t

novelty_claim: This gives a concrete route from obstruction mining to sound pruning, rather than heuristic rejection rules.
differentiation: It explicitly rejects unsound upper-bound-derived filters that only look plausible.
